sentences.text: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption examines controls over government funding for non-government providers of human services.
sentences.support: As human services delivery in NSW transitions to the NGO delivery model

sentences.text: Its research included more than 75 consultation sessions, 33 submissions and case studies of Victoria and Scotland.
sentences.support: The Commission has also considered the issues raised in the 33 submissions it received

sentences.text: The Commission considers that Victoria’s model of local service areas is more suitable for NSW than Scotland’s council-based model without substantial council amalgamations.
sentences.support: the Victorian model is more applicable to NSW than the council-based model of Scotland.

sentences.text: Its 18 recommendations address local decision-making, funding accountability, shared information, central oversight and provider accreditation.
sentences.support: That NSW funding agencies move toward a standards and accreditation framework that assures service and governance capacity.

sentences.text: The Commission also recommends extending the NSW Auditor-General’s powers to audit government-funded non-government organisations.
sentences.support: That legislation be amended to provide the NSW Auditor-General with power to inspect, examine and audit the accounts of NGOs

findings.quote: That legislation be amended to provide the NSW Auditor-General with power to inspect, examine and audit the accounts of NGOs that have been provided with government funding.

notes: Position paper with no separately headed executive summary or overall overview. The 18 recommendations are distributed throughout the chapters; allegations in the context section are omitted.
